title: fix(runtime,cli): a newcomer's first boot is quiet — the empty stub declares its protocol range, and a scaffold's os dev composes one MetadataPlugin

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgBgqBcs88QEaQ8R1f3pax9S)_

domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZgQTno2oPVD2GLd2n

Fixes #29937
Fixes #29936

Clause-②: no — boot diagnostics only; nothing accepted or published changes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** ① 空内核存根 `com.objectstack.empty` 现在声明 `engines.protocol: ^18`（写它的运行时自己的大版本）；旧 CLI 写过的存根（无范围、或别的大版本）在下次 `os start` 时就地补上，只改这一个键，且只改 OS_HOME 下仍是存根的文件。② `os serve` / `os dev` 的 dev artifact door 与 host-config door 共用一个 `hasMetadataPlugin` 判定（先认插件名 `com.objectstack.metadata`，再认类名），dev door 不再在已有 `MetadataPlugin` 的栈上再加一个。
- **为什么改：** 文档首页一行命令 `npm i -g @objectstack/cli && os start` 的首启诊断报「`com.objectstack.empty` 没声明 engines.protocol」，新人既不能修也找不到这个包；`os init -t app` 脚手架上 `os dev` 每次启动都报「Plugin superseded: 'com.objectstack.metadata'」，怪用户配错了一个他没写过的插件。后者的根因：发布的 `@objectstack/metadata` 打包产物写成 `var MetadataPlugin = class _MetadataPlugin`，`constructor.name` 是 `_MetadataPlugin`，dev door 只比类名，所以认不出 standalone stack 已组好的那个；源码跑的测试看不到这个改名。
- **风险与回滚：** 只动启动组装与存根文件。存根刷新只在 OS_HOME 的 `dist/objectstack.json` 且 `manifest.id` 仍是 `com.objectstack.empty` 时发生，别处的同形文件、非 JSON 文件一律不碰（有 pin）。dev door 的判定只比原来多认一种已有插件的写法，host config 没有自己的 `MetadataPlugin` 时照旧组 dev door。两个包各一条 patch changeset。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/runtime/src/default-host.ts` 的 `ensureEmptyBootStub` 与 `createDefaultHostConfig` 里按路径传入时的刷新分支；`packages/cli/src/utils/stack-collections.ts` 的 `hasMetadataPlugin`；`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` 两处门控。
- **两分钟验证：** 空目录、空 HOME 下跑 `os start`：首启诊断里不再出现 `declares no engines.protocol range`，`~/.objectstack/dist/objectstack.json` 带 `"engines": { "protocol": "^18" }`。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

**#29937 — the empty kernel's stub declares its range** (`@objectstack/runtime`, commits 4a5bb322 and 8e3ceadd)

- `ensureEmptyBootStub(stubPath)` (new, in `default-host.ts`; not re-exported from the package index) owns the stub. Absent: it is written with `manifest.engines.protocol` = `^PROTOCOL_MAJOR` (from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`), the major of the runtime that writes it, so it is compatible by construction. Present and still the stub (`manifest.id` is `com.objectstack.empty`) with no range or another major's: only `manifest.engines.protocol` is rewritten. Present and not the stub, or not JSON: left alone; the loader reports it.
- The re-stamp of another major's range is deliberate: a stub stamped `^18` by this CLI would otherwise be refused as `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE` the day the runtime moves to 19, failing the one boot that has nothing in it.
- **Found by the before/after measurement, not in the card:** the empty-boot branch of `createDefaultHostConfig` runs only on the FIRST `os start`. From the second on, the `os start` supervisor resolves `HOME_DIR/.objectstack/dist/objectstack.json` as an artifact rung (`resolveArtifactBootSource`, rung `home-dist`) and hands it down as `artifactPath`, so a stub an older CLI wrote was never reached by the first commit and kept warning (measured, log below). The second commit refreshes the stub on that path too, keyed on the resolved path being exactly the home stub path; a stub-shaped file named anywhere else is left alone.

**#29936 — one `MetadataPlugin` on a scaffold's `os dev`** (`@objectstack/cli`, commit 028a043a)

- `hasMetadataPlugin(plugins)` (new, `utils/stack-collections.ts`, beside `hasObjectQLPlugin` / `hasStorageDriverPlugin`): a plugin named `com.objectstack.metadata`, or a class named `MetadataPlugin`.
- `serve.ts`: the dev artifact door's gate was `!plugins.some((p) => p?.constructor?.name === 'MetadataPlugin')`; the host-config door's was the name-or-class form. Both now read `!hasMetadataPlugin(plugins)`. `createStandaloneStack` is untouched, as the dispatch asked.
- Why only the dev door missed: the published bundle (checked on `@objectstack/metadata@18.3.0` `dist/index.js` and on this branch's own build of `packages/metadata/dist/index.js` and `node.js`, one hit each) declares `var MetadataPlugin = class _MetadataPlugin {`. The host-config door already checked the name, so it was immune; the dev door was not.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/default-host-empty-stub.test.ts` (new, 9 cases): a fresh stub passes the handshake (`checkProtocolCompat(...).status === 'ok'`); a legacy stub (exactly the 18.3.0 bytes' shape) is refreshed with everything else kept; another major's range is re-stamped; a current stub is left byte for byte; a non-stub artifact and a non-JSON file are untouched; through `createDefaultHostConfig`: the legacy stub named as `artifactPath` at the home location is refreshed, the empty boot writes the range, and a stub-shaped file named elsewhere is untouched.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/stack-collections.test.ts`: three `hasMetadataPlugin` cases, one built on the bundle's shape (`class _MetadataPlugin { name = 'com.objectstack.metadata' }`).
- Source pins updated: `serve-host-config-security-registrar.pin.test.ts` (the dev door's gate string) and `serve-host-config-metadata-door.pin.test.ts` (both doors ask `!hasMetadataPlugin(plugins)`, count 2, and no class-name-only spelling is left in `serve.ts`).

## Verification

All readings on head 2041627b (gates: the 61-family run on 8e3ceadd, then the 17 families that read the last commit's file re-run on 2041627b; the last commit adds one `SERVE_ONLY` entry to a cli test).

<details><summary>Real boot, before/after (#29937: os start, empty directory, empty HOME)</summary>

Built CLI of this branch (`node packages/cli/bin/run.js start`, `HOME` a fresh temp dir).

- **Before** (`default-host.ts` restored from a26abbc6, runtime rebuilt; `ensureEmptyBootStub` count in dist 0): `Artifact: none (empty kernel …)`, then `ℹ Boot diagnostics — 1 informational: WARN [AppPlugin] [protocol] package 'com.objectstack.empty' declares no engines.protocol range; loading under protocol 18.0.0 without a compatibility check (ADR-0087).`
- **After, fresh home:** `Server is ready`, no `Boot diagnostics` block; the stub on disk carries `"engines": { "protocol": "^18" }`.
- **After commit 1 only, legacy stub** (the 18.3.0 stub bytes pre-seeded): banner `Artifact: HOME_DIR/.objectstack/dist/objectstack.json` (the `home-dist` rung), the same WARN, stub unchanged. This is what commit 8e3ceadd closes.
- **After commit 2, legacy stub:** no `Boot diagnostics`; the stub now carries `"engines": { "protocol": "^18" }`.
- Restore leg: `git diff HEAD` empty, runtime rebuilt from HEAD (dist `ensureEmptyBootStub(` count 3).

</details>

- **Before** (`serve.ts` restored from a26abbc6, cli rebuilt): `ℹ Boot diagnostics — 1 informational: WARN Plugin superseded: 'com.objectstack.metadata' — the later registration (v1.0.0) REPLACED the earlier one (v1.0.0). …`
- **After** (cli rebuilt from HEAD): `Server is ready`, `superseded` count 0, no `Boot diagnostics` block; `Plugins: 41 loaded` lists `com.objectstack.metadata` once.
- Restore leg: `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; each restored, blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- `hasMetadataPlugin` name clause dropped (`return ctor === 'MetadataPlugin';`): `stack-collections.test.ts` 1 failed / 21 passed — `finds the plugin by its name when the bundle renamed the class`.
- Stub `engines: { protocol: range },` removed: `default-host-empty-stub.test.ts` 3 failed / 6 passed (fresh stub, current-stub-left-alone, empty boot writes the range).
- Named-path refresh disabled (path compared to a sentinel): 1 failed / 8 passed — `refreshes a legacy stub handed in as artifactPath at the home location`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The seat asked for one commit per card. #29937 has two (4a5bb322, 8e3ceadd): the second is the named-path refresh the measurement found after the first was pushed. The branch is `claude/project-thread-*`, not `claude/issue-*`, so AGENTS.md §3 forbids rewriting it; they stay two commits. #29936 likewise gains 2041627b, the boot-parity census entry its unit run asked for.
- The scaffold measurement for #29936 ran this branch's CLI against an `os init my-app -t app` scaffold whose `@objectstack/spec`, `runtime` and `objectql` were linked to this worktree's packages, so both copies of the boot read this branch's builds.
- Not changed: the ADR-0087 `no-range` warning itself, and `createStandaloneStack`.
